ITEM 1 | Whole ovoid piece with a yellow-green skin, mottled with darker green-brown patches and speckles, a dark brown stem cavity at the top, matte surface with slight sheen, firm and intact, about 9-10 cm across, sitting on the upper left of the white square plate | 180
ITEM 2 | Cluster of about 8 red pieces, each cut into halves or thick slices about 3-4 cm long and 1 cm thick, glossy red flesh with small pale seed dots on the surface, firm and moist-looking, arranged in a loose heap on the upper right of the plate, with one small loose piece to its right | 70
